stories.headline: AI industry confronts control and safety fears
stories.summary: Reuters traces ten days in which major labs disclosed agent breaches and several leaders urged slower capability development. Catastrophic-risk estimates remain disputed; companies also continue major fundraising and release plans.

stories.headline: Anthropic weighs new model before planned IPO
stories.summary: Anthropic is considering a new model as OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra gains enterprise share, sources said. The launch is not confirmed and would test Anthropic’s attempt to reconcile competitive pressure with its call for slower development.

stories.headline: Trump announces White House media bans
stories.summary: President Trump said CNN, MS NOW and Politico would be barred from the White House. The ban’s scope was unclear Friday; press-freedom experts and the outlets said broader credential exclusions would face constitutional challenges.

stories.headline: Greenland rejects sovereignty loss in US deal
stories.summary: Denmark and Greenland said a pending US security agreement respects Greenlandic sovereignty, while Trump described permanent US control over security. Key terms remain unpublished, so the practical extent of US authority is unclear.

stories.headline: Russia reports attacks on election systems
stories.summary: Russian officials said online voting and communications were attacked during parliamentary elections and blamed attempted interference on Ukraine without presenting evidence. Authorities said systems remained operational; most anti-war candidates were barred.
